title.narrative: With UNICEF support, the Government made major progress towards influencing policy, financing, and introducing innovative climate resilient service delivery models for water, sanitation, and hygiene (WASH). While access for basic WASH has improved, challenges for safely managed WASH still remain and will be a priority for UNICEF in 2025.
